parameters.query:
SELECT cp.bot_id, cp.user_id, cp.user_id AS chat_id, c.bot_token, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.display_name,''),'') AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.language,''),'Russian') AS language,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM workout_session ws WHERE ws.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND ws.user_id=cp.user_id AND ws.performed_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date) AS workouts,
 COALESCE((SELECT round(sum(e.reps*e.weight_kg)) FROM workout_entry e JOIN workout_session ws ON e.session_id=ws.id WHERE ws.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND ws.user_id=cp.user_id AND ws.performed_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND e.kind='strength' AND e.reps IS NOT NULL AND e.weight_kg IS NOT NULL),0) AS str_vol,
 COALESCE((SELECT round(sum(e.reps*e.weight_kg)) FROM workout_entry e JOIN workout_session ws ON e.session_id=ws.id WHERE ws.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND ws.user_id=cp.user_id AND ws.performed_on >= (now()-interval '14 days')::date AND ws.performed_on < (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND e.kind='strength' AND e.reps IS NOT NULL AND e.weight_kg IS NOT NULL),0) AS str_vol_prev,
 COALESCE((SELECT round((sum(e.distance_m)/1000.0)::numeric,1) FROM workout_entry e JOIN workout_session ws ON e.session_id=ws.id WHERE ws.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND ws.user_id=cp.user_id AND ws.performed_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND e.kind='cardio' AND e.distance_m IS NOT NULL),0) AS cardio_km,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT eaten_on) FROM food_log fl WHERE fl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND fl.user_id=cp.user_id AND fl.eaten_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date) AS food_days,
 (SELECT round(sum(kcal)/NULLIF(count(DISTINCT eaten_on),0)) FROM food_log fl WHERE fl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND fl.user_id=cp.user_id AND fl.eaten_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND kcal IS NOT NULL) AS kcal_day,
 (SELECT round(sum(protein_g)/NULLIF(count(DISTINCT eaten_on),0)) FROM food_log fl WHERE fl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND fl.user_id=cp.user_id AND fl.eaten_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND protein_g IS NOT NULL) AS prot_day,
 (SELECT value FROM measurement m WHERE m.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND m.user_id=cp.user_id AND m.metric IN ('вес','weight') ORDER BY measured_on DESC LIMIT 1) AS weight_now,
 (SELECT value FROM measurement m WHERE m.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND m.user_id=cp.user_id AND m.metric IN ('вес','weight') AND m.measured_on <= (now()-interval '6 days')::date ORDER BY measured_on DESC LIMIT 1) AS weight_prev
FROM client_profile cp JOIN clients c ON c.bot_id=cp.bot_id
WHERE cp.proactive_enabled = true AND cp.onboarding_done = true AND c.bot_type IN ('client','trusted','owner')
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proactive_log pl WHERE pl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND pl.user_id=cp.user_id AND pl.kind='weekly' AND pl.sent_at >= now()-interval '6 days')
 AND ( (SELECT count(*) FROM workout_session ws WHERE ws.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND ws.user_id=cp.user_id AND ws.performed_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date) > 0
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM food_log fl WHERE fl.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND fl.user_id=cp.user_id AND fl.eaten_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date) > 0
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM measurement m WHERE m.bot_id=cp.bot_id AND m.user_id=cp.user_id AND m.measured_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date) > 0 );
INSERT INTO proactive_log (bot_id, user_id, kind) VALUES ($1, $2, 'weekly');
